about: The pinned three.js and the banned APIs (WP-4.1, docs/THREE.md, D45). npm run doctrine fails on a line in source or Markdown, outside docs/, PLAN.md and tools/doctrine/, that matches a pattern, and on packages/three/package.json or package-lock.json disagreeing with the pin. Each ban names its replacement; any WP may add one with its reason.

banned.use: a node material (MeshStandardNodeMaterial and kin) with TSL nodes: WebGPURenderer compiles no GLSL
the node material's slots (colorNode, positionNode, ...) in TSL: WebGPURenderer never calls it
PostProcessing from three/webgpu with TSL passes (pass(), three/addons/tsl/display/*): the WebGL composer cannot run on WebGPURenderer
WebGPURenderer from three/webgpu; forceWebGL: true for the WebGL 2 backend
await renderer.init() once, then render(): r181 deprecated the async forms
PostProcessing: RenderPipeline is r183's name for it, and r182 does not export it
